details.intendedUse: Drafting, research, analysis, and IT/coding assistance. No personal data of members or staff, no credentials or secrets.
details.resources: Anthropic Trust Center and SOC/ISO listings (support.claude.com/en/articles/10015870); Fortune 2026-07-31; The Register 2026-03-31; TechCrunch 2025-08-28; privacy.claude.com training and retention articles; support.claude.com 10440198, 13133195, 13917894; code.claude.com permission modes; Anthropic Usage Policy; Anthropic system cards. Sub-processor list not retrieved.

L1.notes: SOC 2 Type I and Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 are listed by Anthropic. Reports are in the Trust Portal.

L2.notes: Not a confirmed breach of Anthropic-held customer data. Scored Yes because Anthropic disclosed on 2026-07-30 that Claude models (Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, an internal model) compromised three outside organizations' infrastructure during testing; earliest incidents April 2026. The Claude Code npm source leak (2026-03-31) was called a packaging error; Anthropic said no customer data or credentials were exposed.

L3.notes: Aug 2025 consumer terms change: chats used for model training by default unless users opted out by 2025-09-28. Commercial (Team, Enterprise, API) data is excluded by default. See L2 for the 2026 test-breach disclosure.

L4.notes: Founded 2021 and headcount is well above 200. Yes requires BOTH fewer than 200 staff AND under 5 years. Headcount is not stated on Anthropic's company page, so the staff figure is unverified; the age test alone fails.

L5.notes: Anthropic names each Claude model and publishes system cards that describe training data and evaluations.

L6.notes: Assumed purchased through IT procurement. Confirm no card purchase or self-sign-up before approval.

L7.notes: No public third-party security rating located in this pass. Scored as Not rated (2 pts). Re-check with a rating tool at re-review.

L8.notes: No acquisition, merger, or ownership change in the last 12 months found in news search as of 2026-10-21.

L9.notes: Hosting runs on third-party cloud providers (fourth parties). Sub-processor list was not retrieved in this pass; verify before approval.

L10.notes: Claude Code and connectors can edit files, run commands, and call tools. Auto mode uses a classifier instead of a person for each action, so per-action approval is optional.

L11.notes: SSO (SAML/OIDC) is available on Team and Enterprise plans. MFA must be enforced at the identity provider.

L12.notes: Enterprise custom retention: admins set a period (30-day minimum), and data past retention is permanently deleted. Confirm deletion-on-request wording in the signed contract.

I1.notes: Productivity tool, not on a critical path. An outage has manual workarounds.

I2.notes: Not used for finance, payments, or core operations.

I3.notes: Policy limits use to non-PII work: no member or staff personal data, no credentials or secrets. If that limit is not enforced, change to Sensitive.

I4.notes: Confidential business content under the policy limit above.

I5.notes: Requested by DTS; expected use spreads to other teams.

I6.notes: Claude Code and connectors act with the user's permissions on connected systems (for example Microsoft 365 and Azure). Scope through connector permissions.

I7.notes: Intended use excludes data about minors or vulnerable people.

P1.notes: Usage policy bans explicit, violent, deceptive, and degrading content. Safeguards Team monitors violations and real-time safeguards can block outputs.

P2.notes: Commercial data is not used for training by default. The 2025 consumer training change is scored under L3, not here.

P3.notes: Enforceable opt-out exists: owners can turn off feedback ('Rate chats') under Organization settings > Data and Privacy. Submitted feedback may be kept up to 5 years.

M1.notes: DPA and commercial terms exist; signature not verified. Set to Yes once we has signed.

M2.notes: Admin-enforced zero retention is not confirmed. Retention is configurable on Enterprise (see L12).

M3.notes: Enterprise supports SCIM provisioning with SSO. Credit applies only once SSO and SCIM are configured for named users. Change to No if not done.

M4.notes: No DLP or CASB control verified for this tool.
